title: Verse battle soak: corrections just over 1 m, the frontline player stalling, and confirmations on unreceived corpses
body: Follow-up to #10559 (closed as done). The ten-minute 20-player soaks (bench/verse/2026-10-09/battle-soak-600-parallel-sync/) still miss the soak's own gates on: five single corrections of 1.06–1.39 m with 4–5 unconfirmed inputs on open ground (suspected crowd contacts: the client sees other players ~200 ms late; untested); player 19 (frontline) not moving for 80% of snapshots in the GPU-timed run; once, a confirmation that stands the player on a corpse the client hasn't received yet.
